name: Name and position a new brand
why: A guided run from positioning to a name, the same order as the position-name-and-voice workflow.

name: Choose a position, check a name stretch, launch with press
why: Picks a position, tests whether a name can stretch and plans the launch.

name: Pick the one word to own in your customers' minds
why: Narrows positioning to the one idea to own, in line with the canon here.

name: Positioning statement writer
why: Writes one positioning line from buyer evidence and rivals, with the proof it needs.

name: Store name generator
why: Generates a long list and a shortlist with a checklist to clear each name, for shops.

name: Store name tester
why: Scores names with keep, fix or drop calls before a domain or logo is bought.

name: Brand name stretch checker
why: Checks whether a brand name can cover a new product, a key naming-system question.

name: Store brand architecture planner
why: Decides whether a new range gets its own name and sets a naming rule, like the product-naming-system prompt.

name: Store rebrand planner
why: Scores whether to keep, tweak or change a name and plans the change.

name: Write a voice guide from your documents and check copy
why: Builds a voice guide from the client's own writing and checks copy against it, as the voice skills here do.

name: Brand voice reviewer
why: Fixes only the lines that slip and rechecks, the same rule as the voice-and-message-check skill.

name: Make every touchpoint say the same thing
why: Aligns the site, emails, social and sales material to one message.

name: Build a brand file and brand guide from your website
why: Turns a website into a brand file any writer or AI can use, like the brand-fact-file prompt.

name: Company mantra writer
why: Writes a two-to-four-word internal mantra with a pick, useful next to taglines.

name: Fresh line rewriter
why: Rewrites lines that sound like every rival's, checked with a swap test.
